description: A Central Sector scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to enable them to take care of expenses related to agriculture and domestic needs.
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred directly into bank accounts
Payable in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly through Aadhaar-seeded accounts
eligibilityText: Small and marginal landholder farmer families owning cultivable land up to 2 hectares in their name. Institutional landholders and high-income taxpayer families are excluded.
documents: Aadhaar Card
Landholding Ownership Papers (Khata / Khasra / RoR)
Active Bank Account Passbook with IFSC code
Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
applicationProcess: Visit official portal pmkisan.gov.in and click 'Farmers Corner'
Select 'New Farmer Registration' and enter Aadhaar number and state
Fill landholding details and upload relevant land records
Alternatively, visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or State Nodal Officer

schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme offering cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization care across empanelled public and private hospitals.
benefits: Cashless health insurance coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses
Covers approximately 1,949 medical and surgical procedures including medicines and diagnostics
eligibilityText: Deprived and vulnerable rural families and identified occupational categories of urban workers based on SECC 2011 criteria with annual income under ₹2,50,000.
documents: Aadhaar Card or Government Photo ID
Ration Card or Family Identification Document
Income Certificate / SECC Enrolment Record
Registered Mobile Number
applicationProcess: Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in using mobile number or ration card
Visit any empanelled public or private hospital and meet the Ayushman Mitra
Verify Aadhaar identity through e-KYC
Obtain the Ayushman Golden Card for cashless admission

beneficiary: Rural Houseless and Kutcha House Dwellers
description: A flagship housing scheme aimed at providing a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/northeast states
90-95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA (~₹20,000 additional)
Assistance of ₹12,000 for construction of toilet under Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin)
eligibilityText: Families without shelter or living in zero, one or two-room houses with kutcha wall and roof, with annual income not exceeding ₹2,00,000.
documents: Aadhaar Card
MGNREGA Job Card Number
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked)
Certificate of Houselessness / Kutcha house photograph
Income Certificate
applicationProcess: Eligible beneficiaries identified by Gram Sabha from SECC list
Panchayat Secretary or Village Development Officer enters applicant details on AwaasSoft
Geo-tagged inspection photos of existing house uploaded
Funds transferred directly in geo-tagged construction stages to bank account

department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to adult women from poor households to safeguard women and children health by providing clean cooking fuel.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection including security deposit of cylinder and pressure regulator
First LPG refill provided completely free of cost
Hotplate (stove) provided free of cost with connection
eligibilityText: Woman applicant aged 18 years or above belonging to poor household (BPL / SECC / SC / ST / PMAY-G beneficiary) with annual family income under ₹1,50,000 and having no existing LPG connection in household.
documents: Aadhaar Card of the applicant and adult family members
Ration Card or BPL Certificate showing family composition
Bank Account Passbook (IFSC and account number)
Self-declaration of residence proof (Ujjwala 2.0 migrant provision)
applicationProcess: Download or collect Ujjwala 2.0 application form from pmuy.gov.in or local LPG distributor
Submit completed form with Aadhaar and ration card at Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum, or HP Gas agency
Verification conducted by distributor through OMC portal
LPG connection released upon verification

department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance
description: A government-backed pension scheme targeted at citizens in the unorganized sector to provide financial security during old age.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60
Spouse receives exact pension upon death of subscriber
Return of full accumulated pension wealth to nominee upon death of both subscriber and spouse
eligibilityText: All Indian citizens aged between 18 and 40 years holding a savings bank or post office account. Citizen must not be an income taxpayer.
documents: Aadhaar Card
Savings Bank Account or Post Office Account details
Active Mobile Number
applicationProcess: Approach the bank branch or post office where savings account is maintained
Fill the APY Registration Form specifying chosen monthly pension amount and auto-debit consent
Auto-debit begins monthly/quarterly/half-yearly based on entry age
Can also subscribe online via internet banking portals of major banks

department: Department of Posts, Ministry of Finance
description: A government small deposit savings scheme targeted at parents of girl children as part of Beti Bachao Beti Padhao initiative to fund education and marriage expenses.
benefits: Highest government small savings interest rate (~8.2% per annum, compounded annually)
Triple tax exemption (EEE) under Section 80C of Income Tax Act
Maturity on completion of 21 years from account opening or upon marriage after age 18
eligibilityText: Account can be opened by biological parents or legal guardians for a girl child from her birth up to the age of 10 years. Maximum two girl children per family.
documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Identity and Address Proof of parent/guardian (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID)
Photographs of girl child and guardian
applicationProcess: Visit any Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank (SBI, PNB, etc.)
Submit Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form with initial deposit (minimum ₹250)
Submit girl child birth certificate and guardian KYC documents
Account passbook issued upon opening

department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
beneficiary: Micro & Small Business Owners and Entrepreneurs
description: Provides collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises for income-generating activities in manufacturing, processing, trading or service sectors.
benefits: Collateral-free institutional loans with competitive interest rates
Categorized in three tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000), and Tarun (₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000)
Mudra Debit Card provided for working capital withdrawals
eligibilityText: Any Indian citizen aged 18 to 65 years with a viable business plan for non-farm income generating micro enterprises in manufacturing, trading, or service sectors.
documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Proof of Residence (Utility Bill / Aadhaar)
Business Enterprise Registration / License / Udyam Certificate
Quotation for machinery or items to be purchased
Bank Account Statement for last 6 months
applicationProcess: Apply online via Udyami Mitra Portal (udyamimitra.in) or JanSamarth portal
Alternatively, visit any public/private commercial bank, RRB, or NBFC branch
Submit loan application form with business proposal and KYC proofs
Loan disbursed directly upon approval without processing fee for Shishu

schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
beneficiary: Scheduled Caste Students pursuing Higher Education
description: Centrally sponsored scheme to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
benefits: Full compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed directly to educational institutions
Academic allowance / maintenance allowance paid directly to student's bank account
Special disability allowance for students with benchmark disabilities
eligibilityText: Indian national belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) category enrolled in recognized post-matric course with family annual income not exceeding ₹2,50,000.
documents: Caste Certificate issued by authorized Revenue Authority (Tehsildar)
Income Certificate of parents/guardian for current financial year
Previous Class / Degree Marksheet and Passing Certificate
Fee Receipt and Bonafide Certificate of current course enrolment
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account
applicationProcess: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Complete student profile and select 'Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students'
Upload institutional fee structure, caste certificate, and income proof
Application validated at Institute level and State Nodal Officer before DBT disbursement

department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
description: A welfare programme by Government of Andhra Pradesh providing comprehensive input assistance to farmer families including tenant farmers (CCRC holders) across the state.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹13,500 per farmer family per year (inclusive of ₹6,000 PM-KISAN component)
Paid in three installments across Kharif, Rabi, and harvest periods
Includes coverage for ROFR and tenant cultivators belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority communities
eligibilityText: Cultivator farmer families residing in Andhra Pradesh owning agricultural land or recognized tenant farmers under CCRC card, aged 18 or older.
documents: Aadhaar Card
Pattadar Passbook / 1B Adangal or Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC)
Active Bank Account seeded with Aadhaar
Ration Card / Rice Card
applicationProcess: Enrollment and verification conducted at Village Rythu Bharosa Kendras (RBK)
Village Agriculture Assistant (VAA) verifies land records in Webland system
Social audit list displayed at Gram Sachivalayam for transparency
Assistance deposited directly to Aadhaar-enabled bank account

department: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Andhra Pradesh
beneficiary: Middle-aged Women from Backward and Minority Communities
description: Financial assistance program empowering middle-aged women in Andhra Pradesh to set up sustainable retail, dairy, or grocery livelihoods in partnership with corporate partners.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹18,750 per year for four consecutive years (total ₹75,000)
Technical guidance and market linkage support from corporate partners (Amul, ITC, HUL, Reliance)
Full autonomy to invest funds in sustainable micro-business or livestock
eligibilityText: Women aged between 45 and 60 years residing in Andhra Pradesh belonging to SC, ST, BC, or Minority communities with family annual income under ₹1,20,000 (rural) or ₹1,44,000 (urban).
documents: Integrated Caste Certificate
Income Certificate or White Ration Card / Rice Card
Aadhaar Card (with date of birth proof)
Bank Account Passbook (single account in applicant's name)
applicationProcess: Apply through Village/Ward Volunteers or at local Grama/Ward Sachivalayam in Andhra Pradesh
Welfare and Education Assistant conducts door-to-door e-KYC verification
Beneficiary list approved by Municipal Commissioner / MPDO after social audit
Amount directly credited to woman's unencumbered bank account
